mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investments and consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings and reduced consumer demand.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth rate below 2% annually) signals a stable monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors gain confidence in stable economic conditions and lower risk premiums.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL growth rate is below 2% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances when HOUST declines by more than 10%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% in a month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS increases by more than 5%.
